column1: # Ash Jenna, an antagonist, confronts the party in Tolbi after Colosso.

column3:
There you are, Isaac. I've
watched Tolbi's harbor for
three nights.{page_break}Do you know what the
fishermen keep pulling out?{end_wait}
Jenna? You're grey, and\nyou're shaking. Please come\nback with us.{end_wait}
Shaking? No. That's the\nfire finally leaving.{page_break}What's left of me is cold,\nand it doesn't forget.{end_wait}
Jenna, stop this! The girl\nI know wouldn't talk like\nthat!{end_wait}

She wouldn't. She also
wouldn't have lasted this
long.{page_break}Be quiet, Garet. You're
making a scene.{end_wait}
Another one with ash in her\nveins. Let the harbor have\nher too.{end_wait}

Mia. You hear it too, don't
you? That voice in the
blade.{page_break}It's the same hunger that
woke in me.{end_wait}

Light the next one, Isaac.
More will wake, and Tolbi
will drown every one.{page_break}Or you can be kind and
end it quickly. I'll be
watching either way.{end_wait}
